Actor.description:
Who performed the audited action. Append-only provenance record.
Portal variants carry the client-side tier so audit trails distinguish
staff actions from client-portal actions at the storage layer
(actor_kind portal_contact / portal_approver / portal_it_manager).

identity without pretending it row-walked — `"user:<uuid>"` for
admin JWT runs, `"api-key:<key-id>""` for machine pushes. Row-level
mutations still emit their ordinary domain events; the import actor
owns batch-lifecycle provenance (kind "import" in audit storage).

id.description:
Bulk-import runs (TASKLIST D2): the descriptor names the driving
identity without pretending it row-walked — `"user:<uuid>"` for

mutations still emit their ordinary domain events; the import actor

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key. Absent in
legacy clients — purely additive. (Comments are fresh entities, so
there is no version to match.)

attachment_ids.description:
Attachments uploaded earlier against this ticket (composer flow:
upload first, link when the comment is created). Absent/empty in
older clients — purely additive.

ApiKeyCreatedResponse.description:
The ONLY response carrying raw key material. Lost keys are rotated by
creating a new key and revoking this one — never recovered.

Appointment.description:
A booked slot on one user's calendar, optionally tied to a ticket and
client/site. `travel_minutes` is a dispatch-board placeholder — never
interpreted by scheduling rules in this stage.

AppointmentKind.description:
What an appointment is physically for. Drives rendering color-coding on
calendars and future travel-time logic (on_site only).

AppointmentStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a booking. `cancelled` frees the slot (the DB exclusion
constraint's partial predicate); `done` still occupies it.

client_visible.description: Only articles passing the effective client-facing gate.

q.description: Title substring narrowing; ranked full-text search rides /api/search.

group_id.description: `Some(group)` moves the board into that group; `None` ungroups it.

Attachment.description: One uploaded file's metadata row; the payload lives behind `storage_key`.

email_message_id.description: Set only when kind is email_message.

filename.description: Original filename, sanitized (no path components/control chars).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the exact bytes; dedup + integrity anchor.

ticket_comment_id.description: Set only when kind is ticket_comment.

ticket_id.description: Set when kind is ticket_comment or ticket.

uploaded_by_portal_user_id.description:
Portal actor when uploaded through a portal surface (v1: none —
reserved so portal uploads need no schema change).

uploaded_by_user_id.description: Staff uploader when uploaded through the API.

AttachmentDeleted.description:
attachment.deleted — the metadata row went away; `object_removed`
reports whether the backing bytes were reclaimed too (refcount hit 0).

AttachmentKind.description: What an attachment belongs to. The enum value is persisted verbatim.

entity_type.description: Entity type + id the action targeted, when applicable.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when exhausted.

AutomationAction.description:
Effects a rule may request. Every variant maps onto an existing core-api
write path — automations never gain private write routes.

AutomationCondition.description: One predicate; a rule matches only when EVERY condition holds.

user_id.description: Whose windows. Defaults to the caller; another user requires owner/admin.

AvailabilityWindow.description:
One recurring weekly availability template: `weekday` (0 = Monday …
6 = Sunday), local wall-clock `[start_local, end_local)` in `timezone`,
optionally bounded by an effective date range. This is a TEMPLATE —
occurrences are computed, never stored.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the wall-clock bounds live in.

BillingCandidateLine.description:
One draft invoice-line candidate. This is a PREVIEW shape: nothing
persists until Wave 9's invoice run.

amount_minor.description: Line total in minor units (currency on the parent evaluation).

period_start.description:
The billing period (recurring/retainer) or the effective slice of
the evaluation window (T&M) or the fee's due date mirrored into
both ends (fixed fee). Inclusive start, exclusive end for
period-derived lines.

quantity_minutes.description: Labor minutes on the line (T&M/overage); 0 for amount lines.

unit_amount_minor.description:
Unit price in minor units: the hourly rate for labor lines, the
full amount otherwise.

BillingEvaluation.description: The result of evaluating one contract's billing rules over a window.

total_minor.description: Sum of line amounts, minor units.

BillingFrequency.description:
Billing period length. Period boundaries derive from the contract's
`billing_anchor`: the anchor is the first period's start date and each
subsequent period starts one frequency step later (calendar-aware
clamping lives in core-billing's period arithmetic).

BillingLineKind.description: Which billing rule produced a candidate line.

BillingMethod.description:
How the project turns delivered work into money. The value rides the
milestone event payload so core-billing can route without re-reading the
project row (event payloads are additive-only, policy §2).

created_at.description: Users whose favorite this board is (board groups/favorites, Stage 2).

require_checklist_close.description:
Pre-close checklist enforcement toggle (defaults OFF; closing is
gated only when this AND a checklist template are both present —
defaults-first doctrine, migration 0016).

BoardGroup.description:
A named, ordered nav grouping of boards within one org (TASKLIST 2.11).
Groups are organization-wide; `owner_id` records who controls the group.

BoardMember.description:
An explicit per-user membership on one board carrying a board-level
role tier (§6 board-level RBAC). Rows NARROW org grants; absence of a
row leaves org-level governance untouched.

BoardNavEntry.description: One left-nav entry: the board plus the CALLER's annotations.

favorite.description: Whether THIS user favorited the board (star).

group_id.description: Group assignment for the collapsible tree (`None` = ungrouped).

oneOf.description: The caller's board role (`None` = no membership row ⇒ org-governed).

BoardRole.description:
Per-board role tier stored on `board_members` rows (migration 0019,
TASKLIST 2.11). Board roles sit BESIDE the org matrix and can only
narrow it — see `authorize_board_scoped`.

BoardStatus.description:
A per-board status. `category` is the binding contract — labels are
presentation, category is behavior.

is_entry.description: Whether tickets may enter this status directly from New.

BoardTransitionsResponse.description:
GET response for a board's workflow: either its explicit matrix or the
marker that the semantic-category floor governs.

mode.description:
`"explicit"` when the listed edges are authoritative; `"floor"` when
the semantic-category default governs (any→any except closed→open).

BusinessCalendar.description:
Weekly business hours in a named IANA timezone, plus holiday dates.
`None` window = non-business day.

holidays.description: Local dates (YYYY-MM-DD) with no business hours.

maintenance.description:
Downtime stretches subtracted from every measurement. Absent in
legacy documents (`default`) so stored policies keep deserializing.

CalendarExclusion.description: Absolute UTC time-off punching holes in availability.

CalendarItem.description:
Flat merged entry so calendars render one ordered list without caring
which table produced it.

availability_windows.description: Present on personal views only (templates are per-user).

items.description: Merged appointments + on-call, ordered by starts_at then id.

plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

ChecklistItem.description:
One line of a ticket's pre-close checklist. Items instantiated from the
board's template carry `template_item_id`; those are REQUIRED when the
board enforces pre-close checklists (see `crate::notes`). Ad-hoc items
(`template_item_id == None`) never block closure.

ChecklistProgress.description:
Derived-at-read-time checklist progress (never materialized — see the
0016 migration header for the justification). `required_open` counts
unchecked template-derived instances: the close-blocking set when the
board enforces.

ChecklistTemplate.description:
A board's pre-close checklist template. Exactly one per board
(UNIQUE in storage): the deterministic gate consulted at close time.

ChecklistTemplateItem.description:
One required step in a template. Instances on tickets link back to this
id (`checklist_items.template_item_id`), so enforcement follows identity,
never fragile text matching.

ChecklistTemplateView.description:
GET /api/boards/{id}/checklist-template response: the template (if any),
its items, and the enforcement posture actually applied at close time.

ChunkSummaryWire.description:
u32-friendly mirror of [`core_domain::import_core::ChunkSummary`] so the
generated SDK gets plain integers without overflow caveats.

restricted_to.description:
Optional per-client visibility: when set, only these users (plus
admins) can see the client. Empty = all org members.

exclude_appointment_id.description: Appointment excluded from the check (its own id when rescheduling).

ConflictPolicy.description:
Per-entity conflict semantics when an external key already maps to a
live row whose content differs from the incoming spec.

ConflictView.description: One blocking booking named by the dry-run.

Contract.description:
A commercial agreement with one client. Money fields are integer minor
units (cents for USD) — floats are forbidden near amounts (§5).

billing_anchor.description: Required for recurring/retainer; the first billing period's start.

oneOf.description: Required for recurring/retainer; the period cadence.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; every amount on the contract uses this currency.

effective_from.description: First day the agreement can generate billable candidates.

hourly_rate_minor.description:
Default hourly rate for T&M when no rate card row matches the
entry's `work_type`, minor units per hour.

included_minutes.description: Retainer: labor minutes included in each period's base price.

number.description: Human contract number, unique per org (e.g. "C-2026-014").

overage_rate_minor.description: Retainer: hourly rate for minutes beyond the included block.

ContractDetail.description:
The contract aggregate as one view: the agreement plus its rate card
and fee schedule.

ContractFixedFee.description:
Fixed-fee schedule entry: becomes a candidate line when `due_on` falls
inside the evaluation window (and the effective window).

effective_on.description: Only contracts effective on this date.

ContractRate.description:
T&M rate card row: the hourly rate for time entries whose `work_type`
matches `work_type`. Entries with no matching row bill at the
contract's default `hourly_rate_minor`.

Lifecycle. `draft` contracts evaluate in previews (plan before
activation) but Wave 9's invoice runs will refuse them; `cancelled`
contracts never evaluate. `ended` keeps evaluating candidates whose
dates fall inside the (closed) effective window.

ContractType.description: The four supported commercial agreement shapes.

travel_minutes.description: Dispatch placeholder, stored verbatim (RoutingProvider comes later).

user_id.description:

booking for someone else requires owner/admin.

sections.description: The customization sections. Always fully serialized.

Local date in the TARGET user's timezone. Day view: the day itself.

today in that timezone.

Wire shape of one declaration. Kinds/options are flattened so generated
clients can render editors directly from this payload.

visibility.description: "ui" renders an editable row; "hidden" is state readable via values.

response_status.description: HTTP status when a response arrived; null for transport failures.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page; absent when exhausted.

DependencyListResponse.description:
A task's direct finish-to-start dependencies (full rows, so the client
renders "blocked by" without extra fetches).

DispatchAppointment.description:
One booking block on the dispatch board: the appointment plus the
ticket number and client name the block face renders.

DispatchDayQuery.description:
One dispatch-path query: `date` is a LOCAL date interpreted as the
UTC day window (documented UTC scope).

date.description: The day to assemble; defaults to today (UTC).

DispatchDayView.description: The assembled day-view payload: one request, one render.

unassigned.description:
Unassigned, non-closed tickets in dispatch order (priority rank,
then effective SLA/due deadline).

Document.description:
A document's living handle. No content lives here — content is only
ever a [`DocumentVersion`]; `current_version` names the newest one.

current_version.description: The newest version number in the document's history.

q.description: Title substring narrowing; ranked full-text search rides /api/search.

DocumentMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): document fields at the top
level plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

DocumentVersion.description:
One immutable snapshot in a document's append-only history. Every
version stores its complete title + body, so any pair is diffable
without reconstructing intermediate state.

change_summary.description: Optional human explanation of what changed in this version.

restored_from_version.description:
Set when this version was created by a RESTORE: the historical
version whose content was copied. Restore-creates-new-version is
the only way old content comes back — history is never rewritten.

DocumentView.description:
GET /api/documents/{id} response: the living handle plus the CURRENT
version's content (read-your-write on the body the last write stored).

label.description: Free-form run label recorded with the dry-run history entry.

DryRunRequest.description:
POST /api/imports/dry-run request: validate a full payload and report
what each row WOULD do before any data write. The probe is recorded as a
finished dry-run batch for operator history.

actions.description: AutomationAction documents, parsed and validated via core-domain.

EntityKind.description:
Which entity family a batch targets. One batch = exactly one kind; the
parent-before-child ordering across batches (clients → sites → contacts)
keeps foreign references resolvable without cross-batch transactions.

EscalationStep.description: One escalation ladder step as stored (`sla_escalation_steps`).

notify_user_ids.description: Extra recipients beyond the ticket assignee.

FieldDefView.description:
Wire view of one field definition; choice kinds carry their closed
option set so generated clients can render editors directly.

board_id.description: Owning board (`None` = org-wide; v1 always creates board-scoped).

options.description: Closed option set for select/multiselect; empty otherwise.

FieldKindWire.description:
The definition kinds (mirror of migration 0009's CHECK set). Kept as a
string-newtype wire enum so unknown kinds fail validation, not deserialization.

nudge_sent_at.description: When the EOD run nudged for this day, if it did.

from.description: Inclusive local-day start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

user_id.description: Manager report only: whose days. Requires owner/admin.

version (of the newly created project). Absent in legacy clients —
purely additive.

assignee_map.description:
Resolves template `assignee_key`s to user ids at instantiation
time; unmapped keys simply leave those tasks unassigned.

category_id.description: Survives category deletion (the FK is ON DELETE SET NULL).

client_visible.description: The article half of the client-facing gate (portal v2 honors it).

KbArticleStatus.description:
Article lifecycle. Closed vocabulary so filtering and the client-facing
rule stay deterministic: `draft` (staff authoring), `published`
(readable, searchable), `archived` (retired, out of the active tree —
content edits are refused while archived; unarchive to edit).

KbCategory.description: A KB category: grouping + ordering for the article tree.

client_visible.description:
The category half of the client-facing gate: an article is visible
to portal clients only when this AND the article flag are set (and
the article is published).

slug.description:
Stable per-org handle (unique); portals and imports reference this,
never the row id.

at_pct.description: Fires when consumed budget reaches this percent (1..=500).

LoginResponse.description:
Login outcome: tokens directly, or a short-lived MFA bridge token when
any second factor is enrolled. Untagged so legacy clients that ignore
`mfa_required` keep parsing the plain token pair they always got.

methods.description: Second factors able to satisfy this login.

MaintenanceWindow.description:
Planned downtime: an absolute UTC interval during which SLA clocks do
not consume business-time budget (vendor maintenance, change freezes).

ManifestApiKey.description:
API-key metadata. `key_hash` (the credential verifier) and the raw key
material are structurally absent — only the display prefix survives.

board_id.description: Board the rule is scoped to; null = every board in the org.

trigger_event.description: Domain event type from the envelope, e.g. `ticket.created`.

require_checklist_close.description: Pre-close checklist enforcement toggle (workflow discipline flag).

statuses.description:
Custom statuses; ALWAYS one per semantic category (defaults-first
seeding guarantees category coverage, never removed by edits).

transitions.description:
Explicit transition adjacency between this board's statuses. Empty
means the semantic-category floor applies (any→any except identity
and closed→open), not "no transitions".

ManifestBoardStatus.description:
One custom status, bound to its semantic category. Renames and colors
never change behavior — consumers must branch on `category`, not `name`.

category.description:
Semantic category: open | in_progress | waiting | closed. THE
binding every SLA/automation/reporting behavior keys on.

is_entry.description: Tickets may enter this status directly at creation.

ManifestCustomField.description:
One custom field definition. `config` is the kind-specific document
(select options, validation bounds, …) exactly as stored.

archived_at.description:
Present when the definition was archived (still a customization the
preflight must see; the values it shaped may still exist).

entity.description: Entity the field attaches to: ticket | client | contact | asset.

kind.description: Field kind: text | number | date | select | multiselect | bool | url | user.

at_pct.description: Percent of the target's business-time budget consumed at firing.

notify_user_ids.description: JSON array of user ids to notify.

ManifestSections.description:
Section container. All fields are always present; empty org state is an
empty array, never an absent key. New sections append here.

api_keys.description: API-key metadata minus secret material (no hashes, no raw keys).

boards.description:
Per-board workflow: the board identity plus its statuses (each bound
to a semantic category — the defaults-first guarantee) and its
explicit transition adjacency. An EMPTY transitions array means the
semantic-category floor applies, not "no transitions".

custom_fields.description:
Custom field definitions across all entities (tickets, clients,
contacts, assets), including archived ones.

settings.description:
Org-scope settings-registry overrides (user-scope rows are per-user
preferences, not org customization).

sla.description: SLA configuration: calendars and policies with escalation ladders.

webhooks.description: Webhook subscriptions with event-type filters, never secrets.

ManifestSlaCalendar.description: One named SLA calendar row with its flattened business calendar body.

calendar.description: Timezone / weekday windows / holidays / maintenance document.

ManifestSlaPolicy.description:
One SLA policy with its targets document, embedded fallback calendar,
calendar attachment, and escalation ladder.

calendar_id.description: Attached named calendar; null keeps the embedded one authoritative.

targets.description: Targets document keyed by priority string.

ManifestTransition.description: One allowed status change, `from` → `to`, both ids from the SAME board.

ManifestWebhook.description:
One webhook subscription. The HMAC signing secret is structurally
absent: it exists only at creation time and in the sealed column.

event_types.description: Event-type filter; empty array = wildcard (all event types).

marked.description: Rows flipped from unread to read (idempotent under retry).

mfa_token.description: The `mfa_token` from POST /api/auth/login when mfa_required was set.

MoveSpec.description: One move in a batch: the booking's new user and slot.

as the additive `mutation` object alongside the entity fields.

before.description: Prior entity snapshot (the undo substrate). `null` on creates.

idempotency_key.description:
The idempotency key that claimed this result, when the caller
supplied one.

seq.description:
Monotonic per-entity sequence: strictly increases by one per
applied write, so clients order reconciliations against the event
stream.

version.description:
Version token for If-Match-style writes; mirrors `seq`. Echo it in
the next write's `version` field.

MutationParams.description:
The autosave mutation parameters every gated create/update body carries
(flattened into the request struct — purely additive fields).

Idempotency key: the same key with the same payload replays the
SAME stored result (never double-applies); the same key with a

Portal role tiers. `contact` is the default read/reply tier;
`approver` is behaviorally identical in v1 but exists so approval

`org_default`, or `builtin`), the channel toggles, and the quiet-hours
window with its timezone.

`None`).

ProjectInstantiateResponse.description:
The instantiation result: the applied project plus the expansion
counts (clients render "created N phases, M tasks" without refetching).

Instant-first mutation response for the project entity (IF2): applied
snapshot at the top level plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

A phase groups tasks into a delivery stage. A phase flagged
`is_milestone` is itself a billing milestone.

A unit of project work. A task flagged `is_milestone` is a billing
milestone: completing it emits `project.milestone_completed`.

A reusable project blueprint. `spec` follows `core-projects::template`
(`TemplateSpec`, additive-only evolution); instantiation is a plain
transactional insert plan — templates are data, not code (policy §5).

ProjectView.description:
A saved task-list view: filter/group/sort spec over one project's tasks
(`project_id: None` = org-wide). The `spec` is a versioned, additive-only
JSON document validated at the route layer; unknown fields are tolerated
(policy §2 posture for declared customizations-as-data).

require_checklist_close.description: Enforcement toggle (defaults-first: OFF until explicitly enabled).

substrings via the trigram fallback.

total.description: Total matches across all permitted kinds.

parent_id.description: comment → its ticket id; NULL otherwise.

snippet.description: Raw body excerpt for client-side snippet rendering.

billable-work metadata, not a transient UI state.

current.description: True for the session making the request.

depends_on.description:

semantics): every id must be a task of the same project; the set
must not create a cycle (typed 422 names the offending edge).

edges.description:
The complete allowed matrix. Empty list returns the board to
floor-mode governance.

its declaration's kind or the write is rejected (validation is applied
before persistence, never after).

value.description: Free text with a hard length cap.

richer structures are entities, not settings.

post.summary:
POST /api/auth/login — resolves the org by email (SECURITY DEFINER
bridge), verifies the argon2 hash under RLS scope. When any second
factor is enrolled, returns a short-lived `mfa_pending` bridge instead
of tokens; POST /api/auth/mfa/verify completes it.

and stores it sealed+unconfirmed. Re-calling restarts enrollment safely.

POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/enroll-verify — confirms the enrollment with the
first valid code and issues the one-time recovery-code batch.

POST /api/auth/mfa/verify — completes an MFA-gated login with a TOTP or
recovery code. Tries TOTP first (advancing the replay watermark), then
falls back to single-use recovery codes.

POST /api/auth/mfa/webauthn/register/begin — starts a passkey
registration for the authenticated user.

POST /api/auth/mfa/webauthn/register/finish — verifies the attestation
and stores the passkey. The public key is stored; no secret exists.
